### Bible Pathways - Feb. 25, 2008
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-feb-25-2008-11568985.html
Passage: Numbers 28:1-2
Points:
- Sacrifices were appointed to lead God's people into grateful acknowledgment of His mercy, protection, and provision.
- The Lord expresses a tender personal interest in receiving offerings that are pleasing to Him.
- An acceptable gift to God is fundamentally about becoming the people He created us to be rather than mere ritual.
- Believers experience genuine fellowship with God when worshiping Him through obedient love and appreciation.
